title: The Slag-Hound quest ('Miners at the head-frame complain of something prowling the downs after dark') gave bearings naming 'Quarry north-east; Old Cairn west edge; Gibbet Tower far north-east; scrappers' camp east', but ~15 turns of wandering the Iron Downs grid (Tally Rise, Marker Stone, Long Spoil, Cracked Adit, High Cut, Windbreak Ridge, Cinder Shrine Approach, etc.) never surfaced a slag-hound or those named landmarks by name; the quest stayed on the final 'Left undone' list.
where: Iron Downs / The Head-Frame — 'The Slag-Hound' quest
